Paper Name: Techno-economic Assessment of a Hydrogen-based Islanded Microgrid in North-east
NOTES: Paper: Hasan et al., 2023, Energy Reports 9, 3380-3396. System: green hydrogen-based islanded microgrid on Thursday Island, Australia (Horn Island for H2 production). Uses HOMER Pro. Three scenarios (100%, 80%, 50% renewable); 80% renewable used as primary/baseline scenario per author recommendation. TOTAL ANNUAL LOAD DEMAND: daily avg load 67,692 kWh x 365 = 24,717,780 kWh (inferred). LCOE: 0.78 AU$/kWh for 80% renewable baseline; LCOE ranges 0.37-1.08 AU$/kWh across scenarios. COE not separately reported; LCOE used. LPSP not reported. rated_PV: not reported as per-panel kW; PV system cost 3350 AU$/kW given. rated_power: 3000 kW per wind turbine unit (Leitwind 101). Cap_H2: 4500 kg for 80% scenario. Cap_FC: 3.6 MW for 80% scenario. Cap_EL: 12 MW for 80% scenario. Cap_DG: 1.01 MW for 80% scenario (existing genset, cost=0). H_min_percentage: 35% electrolyser minimum load ratio. eta_PV: 16% PV efficiency. eta_FC: 60% fuel cell efficiency. eta_EL: 80% electrolyser efficiency. eta_INVT: 95% converter/inverter efficiency. H2_LHV: 33.36 kWh/kg (energy density of 1 kg hydrogen). c_WT: not directly reported as per-kW cost; capital cost 7,300,000 AU$/Unit (each 3 MW unit). c_DG_cap: 0 (existing diesel gensets, already operational). c_FC duplicated as both capital (2000 AU$/kW) and O&M (0.01 AU$/kW/yr). om_PV: 30 AU$/kW/yr. om_WT: 549 AU$/Unit/yr (per turbine unit, not per kW). c_DG_FUEL: 1.3 AU$/L diesel terminal gate price. r: 4.07% discount rate. Inflation rate: 1.5% (additional info). life_FC: 50,000 h (fuel cell lifetime in hours, not years). life_DG: not explicitly stated; remaining life mentioned as 40,000 h. N_WT: 7 units of 3 MW wind turbines for 80% scenario (21 MW total). N_DG: 1 genset (1.01 MW) for 80% scenario. Pipeline capital cost: AU$19.04 million (3 km subsea H2 pipeline). CO2 reduction: 97% for 80% scenario. All costs in AUD (Australian Dollars).
